name: Indirect Bipartite Property via Alternating Parity
description: Instead of explicitly stating the graph can be divided into "two vendors" or "two camps" (which immediately triggers the "bipartite" keyword and BFS two-coloring shortcuts in LLMs), the bipartite guarantee is expressed mathematically: there exists a hidden assignment of integers where every collision pair has an absolute difference of exactly 1. This completely preserves the bipartite guarantee (since such integers exist if and only if the graph is bipartite, via parity) but forces the model to genuinely deduce the alternating parity rather than relying on surface-level keyword matching.
